instance_description:
Setting: BrightGate Transit Analytics is a Chicago software company supporting route-performance dashboards for regional bus and rail agencies throughout 2026.
Scope: Scenarios may cover client check-ins, support escalation tracking, release communications, webinar preparation, data-feed onboarding, accessibility follow-up, renewal readiness, and internal account summaries.
Resources: Reusable structure includes staff profile records, customer success work registers, professional contacts, and blank text files for agendas, release notes, and training outlines.
Exclusions: The Instance excludes software coding, sales commission decisions, legal contracting, payroll, household management, school coursework, personal finance, and any scenario-specific facts before later initialization.
personal_description:
Identity: Ines Valora Keene is a customer success operations specialist at BrightGate Transit Analytics, working from the company’s Chicago office with remote collaboration across transit-agency clients.
Responsibilities: She organizes account check-ins, tracks nontechnical support follow-up, prepares client-facing training materials, coordinates release messaging, and summarizes operational risks for account managers.
Authority: Ines may update internal account records, draft professional communications, schedule routine meetings, request client materials, and prepare documentation for approved customer success expenses.
Restrictions: She cannot change production software, approve discounts, sign contracts, promise custom engineering work, handle payroll, disclose confidential agency data unnecessarily, or commit unapproved spending.
